crossRefs.note: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
(yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

translations.web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
translations.bsb: Behold, I will open my mouth; my address is on the tip of my tongue.
translations.kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
translations.asv: Behold now, I have opened my mouth; My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
